claims.statement: The two-stage merge discipline — iteration integration on develop and the round-level develop→master merge — must never run in the same step, because a master merge before every feature has landed merges a state that was never verified end to end.

`develop` and `master` synchronise by reset only (`git reset --hard master` then `--force-with-lease`), never by rebasing develop or merging master back into it: the no-fast-forward topology is the rollback history.
The merge ritual ends with `git push origin master` and an unpushed trunk counts as an incomplete merge — a local merge that never reached origin is not a release.
Deployment accepts master refs only and every deployment is reported and approved before it runs; there is no override switch, because deployment is the one write that leaves this machine.
